verdict.rationale: Floot provides a managed Postgres database, but nothing in the evidence lets users pick a hosting region or data-residency location for it. The only related item is the option to export the code and database and self-host them elsewhere. That is a user-side workaround, not an in-product residency control, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
